sourceReview: Import rejects non-file URLs and known nonregular final paths before coordination; descriptor checks remain authoritative after coordination.

BoundedFileReader opens with O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK/O_CLOEXEC, requires an opened regular file, rejects metadata size over 8 MiB, reads at most maximumBytes + 1 using chunks no larger than 64 KiB, and closes the handle through defer.
Successful security-scope acquisition is balanced by a defer encompassing preflight, file coordination, bounded read, decoding and thrown errors; false acquisition is permitted for sandbox paths.

Cancellation handles pre-cancel, install/cancel ordering, coordinator cancellation, read checkpoints, decoder return and asynchronous result publication. The production caller also checks cancellation/request identity before starting the library commit.
Coordinated accessor uses the URL supplied by Foundation, propagates coordination errors, and does not mutate source bytes. Export holds immutable validated encoded bytes capped at 8 MiB.

Native test source covers round trip/source preservation, oversize, symbolic link/directory/FIFO rejection with timeout, malformed/non-file inputs, presenter error, cancellation while presenter holds coordination, and pre-cancelled synchronous/asynchronous readers.
